title: Tiny, cute tractor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#1a3a5c'/>

  <!-- background field hint -->
  <rect x='8' y='60' width='84' height='20' fill='#2ecc71' opacity='0.25' rx='3'/>

  <!-- rear big wheel -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='70' r='16' fill='#333344'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='70' r='13' fill='#4a4a5e'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='70' r='9' fill='#5a5a70'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='70' r='5' fill='#7a7a90'/>
  <!-- wheel treads -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='70' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#555568' stroke-width='2' stroke-dasharray='3 4'/>

  <!-- front small wheel -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='74' r='10' fill='#333344'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='74' r='7.5' fill='#4a4a5e'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='74' r='4' fill='#5a5a70'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='74' r='2' fill='#7a7a90'/>

  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x='58' y='38' width='4' height='12' fill='#8888aa' rx='1'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='37' r='3' fill='#aaaacc'/>

  <!-- tractor body -->
  <rect x='28' y='48' width='48' height='20' fill='#e74c3c' rx='4'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x='30' y='50' width='44' height='6' fill='#f06a5a' rx='2' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- cabin/roof -->
  <rect x='50' y='30' width='22' height='20' fill='#e74c3c' rx='3'/>
  <rect x='52' y='32' width='18' height='14' fill='#5bc0de' rx='2' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- seat -->
  <rect x='42' y='44' width='10' height='6' fill='#c0392b' rx='2'/>

  <!-- engine hood -->
  <rect x='62' y='42' width='16' height='10' fill='#c0392b' rx='2'/>
  <rect x='64' y='44' width='12' height='2' fill='#e67e22' rx='1'/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='50' r='4' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='50' r='2' fill='#fff9c4'/>

  <!-- smiley on body -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='56' r='2' fill='#f9e547'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='56' r='2' fill='#f9e547'/>
  <path d='M44 60 Q48 64 52 60' fill='none' stroke='#f9e547' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- steering wheel -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='34' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#555568' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='34' x2='56' y2='40' stroke='#555568' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- little puff of smoke -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#ddddee' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='28' r='3' fill='#ddddee' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='25' r='2' fill='#ddddee' opacity='0.3'/>
</svg>
